item.title: Best Early Amazon Black Friday Deals (2026)
item.description: For die-hard Amazon shoppers, the retail giant starts Black Friday deals on November 19. But you can already stock up on early deals now.

item.title: Snap Specs are big, bold, and quirky, but they can't turn me into Tony Stark
item.description: I got some hands-on time with Snap's 6th-gen Specs AR glasses. They're still pretty big (or bold), but the view is wider (not wide enough), and the experiences are intriguing. I still wonder about the look, the field of view, and that price tag.

item.title: A viral TikTok trend is turning ordinary photos into something unexpectedly emotional
item.description: The latest nostalgia trend encourages users to pair old photos with present-day footage, creating moving snapshots of personal growth and change. Looking back through old photographs often happens in a family living room, turning the pages of a loved one’s photo albums. But on TikTok, the nostalgic ritual is its own trend, and it’s set to the tune of Pink Floyd....

item.title: Is DDR4 back? 64GB RAM PCs see major fall, but new data suggests hope is on the horizon
item.description: Rising RAM prices are changing PC buying habits, with 64GB systems falling sharply and DDR4 maintaining its lead over DDR5.

item.title: Meta warns some of its AI glasses may get 'too warm' if they get wet
item.description: A software update will tell users if they're affected and direct them to Meta's customer support for a full replacement.

item.title: The Disney+ app on Meta Quest now includes 3D movies
item.description: Meta is starting to sell 3D films too.

item.title: How ‘key person risk’ derails companies—and poses problems for Nvidia amid Jensen Huang scandal
item.description: The bigger the presence of a leader or CEO, the bigger the fallout for the organization. When companies put all their faith and trust in one powerful leader, backup plans when things go south are hard to come by. Just ask Nvidia. The world’s second most valuable company (but as of today, the third) is currently in the throes of a major PR scandal that hasn’t just shaken trust in the tech company’s leader, but in the entire company.Over the weekend, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admitted to having an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. Amid the controversy, the company announced it would launch an i...

item.title: Yes, government officials confirm, the Jensen Huang scandal is really, really bad
item.description: Trump is brushing off the affair, but current and former D.C. tech experts warn of serious national security risks. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has found himself embroiled in a scandal involving an alleged affair, a suspected Chinese spy, and some of America’s most closely guarded technology. Not exactly your garden-variety corporate indiscretion.

item.title: Gen Z and millennials are rapidly taking advantage of this health insurance tip for freelancers
item.description: Recent data suggests that it’s a trend on the rise over the last half decade. When Madelyn Roman, 31, wanted to go freelance, the biggest barrier she faced wasn’t how she would make money, but how she would afford healthcare.

item.title: Qui est Joon Kim, l’ancien procureur choisi par Nvidia pour enquêter sur Jensen Huang
item.description: Nvidia confie l'enquête interne sur son propre patron à Joon H. Kim, un ancien procureur fédéral de Manhattan réputé pour sa fermeté. Un profil poids lourd choisi pour rassurer Washington et Wall Street, à une semaine de résultats trimestriels sous haute tension.

item.title: Tech cannibalization to become mainstream? Removing expensive components and reballing memory set to reach 7–9% of smartphones by 2027
item.description: Reballing allows recovered memory chips to be reused, helping manufacturers control expenses while raising questions about consistency and device longevity.

item.title: OpenAI acquires Odessia, travel startup created by Sonder founder
